description: This file contains utility functions for managing and processing VNDK snapshot data, including path handling, version checking, and build artifact retrieval.

methods.name: set_logging_config
methods.description: Configures logging level based on verbose level.

methods.name: check_call
methods.description: Runs a command using subprocess.check_call with debug logging.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs a command using subprocess.check_output with debug logging.

methods.name: vndk_version_int
methods.description: Converts VNDK version string to int and checks if supported.

methods.name: get_android_build_top
methods.description: Retrieves ANDROID_BUILD_TOP environment variable or exits if missing.

methods.name: join_realpath
methods.description: Joins paths and returns the real (absolute) path.

methods.name: _get_dir_from_env
methods.description: Gets directory path from environment variable or default, returns real path.

methods.name: get_out_dir
methods.description: Gets the output directory based on environment or default.

methods.name: get_dist_dir
methods.description: Gets the distribution directory based on environment or default.

methods.name: get_snapshot_archs
methods.description: Returns sorted list of VNDK snapshot architectures under install_dir.

methods.name: prebuilt_arch_from_path
methods.description: Extracts architecture (e.g., 'arm', 'arm64') from a relative path.

methods.name: snapshot_arch_from_path
methods.description: Extracts VNDK snapshot architecture from a relative path.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds files matching given names within a directory tree.

methods.name: fetch_artifact
methods.description: Fetches build artifacts from Android build server.

methods.name: get_latest_vndk_bid
methods.description: Retrieves the latest successful VNDK build ID from Android build server.
